name: Our Generation
description: Lin Qile and Jiang Qiaoxi reconnect in high school after a childhood friendship and a lingering misunderstanding. As they navigate youth's ups and downs alongside their classmates, they grow through shared experiences and step into new horizons.

videos.title: Transfer Student
videos.overview: Lin Yingtao, who grew up in the Mount Qun worksite, encounters Jiang Qiaoxi, the transfer student. Jiang Qiaoxi is a loner. He's transferred to Mount Qun Primary School due to his father's job transfer. Jiang Qiaoxi encounters Yingtao at the principal's office by accident, where she's trying to steal a book. Yingtao misunderstands the encounter and thinks that he's the Grim Reaper. She tries to resolve the crisis by bribing him with candies and requesting her classmates to welcome Jiang Qiaoxi with open arms.

videos.title: Falling Out between Old Friends
videos.overview: Lin Yingtao's beloved rabbit dies. She wants to tell Jiang Qiaoxi, who loves the rabbit as much as she does, about it. She finally decides to gather the letters she has written over the years into a notebook and send the notebook to him.

videos.title: A New Chapter at School
videos.overview: After transferring to a new school, Lin Yingtao moves with her family to the Dianjian residential compound. The parents warmly welcome them and celebrate their arrival. Meanwhile, Jiang Qiaoxi’s behavior is puzzling. He shows care for Yingtao in front of others, yet privately probes her feelings toward him.

videos.title: Gossip
videos.overview: Yu Qiao suggests going to the aquarium which Qin Yeyun wants to go but Yu Qiao and Yingtao are the only ones who go there. Cen Xiaoman and Fei Linge take pictures of Yu Qiao and Yingtao having fun and gossip about their relationship.

videos.title: The Cat and the Rabbit
videos.overview: Yingtao finds a stray cat in the school's courtyard. She never expects Jiang Qiaoxi to be its secret owner. Yingtao sees the gentle look on his face when he cares for the cat. She's reminded of her rabbit, which he neglected.

videos.title: Power of Keeping Promises
videos.overview: Jiang Qiaoxi tells Yingtao what happened in the past. He once ran away from home in order to keep the promise he made to him, but he failed. Yingtao is heartbroken upon hearing that.

videos.title: Rumors
videos.overview: The students misunderstand the relationship between Lin Yingtao and Yu Qiao. Puzzled by the weird looks from them, they decide to ask Fei Linge about it.

videos.title: Special Training
videos.overview: Ying Tao and Yu Qiao join the after-school tuition class together. Physics is a tough subject for her. She always fails to understand it. Yu Qiao believs that one has to have fun in order to learn. He brings Ying Tao outside for her to experience the charm of Physics.

videos.title: Basketball Baby
videos.overview: Ying Tao is unhappy that Qin Ye Yun stood her up but she doesn't know that Qin Ye Yun is absent because his father has been hospitalized. Thus, Ying Tao doesn't know how to comfort Qin Ye Yun...

videos.title: Unspoken Feelings
videos.overview: Jiang Qiao Xi finally gathers the courage to tell his uninvolved father how he has felt all these years. At the same time, Lin Ying Tao stands up to Chen Xiao Man's accusations and provocations by boldly speaking her mind.

videos.title: You Are My Hero
videos.overview: Lin Yingtao faces Liang Hongfei bravely. Jiang Qiaoxi gives Yingtao a letter through the window after finding out what she did for him.

videos.title: Choosing His Own Path
videos.overview: Under Yingtao's care and encouragement, Jiang Qiaoxi completes the Mathematical Olympiad exam despite feeling unwell.

videos.title: The Freedom He Deserves
videos.overview: Seeing how much Lin Yingtao cares for him, Jiang Qiaoxi decides to reclaim his life.

videos.title: Attachment
videos.overview: Lin Yingtao is mad at Jiang Qiaoxi for not telling her that he'll be studying abroad. When she finds out about Jiang Qiaoxi's determination, she chooses to respect his decision.

videos.title: Well Wishes
videos.overview: Jiang Qiaoxi and Lin Yingtao don't talk as often as they used to. Preoccupied with her studies and exam preparation, Yingtao doesn't notice the adults are keeping something from her.

videos.title: University Check-in
videos.overview: Lin Yingtao heads to university on her own, only to find herself assigned to a dorm with senior students. She struggles to connect with them, feeling the weight of their age gap.

videos.title: Childhood Sweethearts
videos.overview: A male student wants to be friends with Lin Yingtao. Yingtao remains unmoved. Her feelings for Jiang Qiaoxi have never changed.

videos.title: Lost Contact
videos.overview: Cai Fangyuan sees a recent picture of Jiang Qiaoxi online. Qin Yeyun tells the gang not to tell Yingtao about it...

videos.title: Our Time Apart
videos.overview: Yu Qiao tells Lin Yingtao where Jiang Qiaoxi is. With her parents' support, Yingtao travels to Hong Kong alone.

videos.title: Running Away
videos.overview: Yingtao forces Jiang Qiaoxi to confront his true feelings, leaving him so emotionally overwhelmed that he runs away. With help from his young landlord, Yingtao tracks him down near the construction site.

videos.title: Facing It Together
videos.overview: Tired of waiting for him to open up, Yingtao bares her heart to Jiang Qiaoxi — reminding him she loves him just as he is.

videos.title: Relationship Announced
videos.overview: Under the Ferris wheel, Jiang Qiaoxi talks about his past, which he cried inside a Ferris wheel's cabin alone.

videos.title: Living Well
videos.overview: Lin Yingtao and Jiang Qiaoxi treat his young landlord, who has been looking after Jiang Qiaoxi, to a meal. The landlord feels genuinely happy for Jiang Qiaoxi.

videos.title: A Better Version of Myself
videos.overview: Lin Yingtao and Jiang Qiaoxi have a long-distance relationship. They bond through making video calls frequently. They stare out at each of their windows respectively, yet their hearts inch closer.
